newsitem.title: USA: Indiana soybean seeding nears 90 percent complete.
newsitem.headline: Indiana soybean seeding nears 90 percent complete.

text.p: Soybean seeding in Indiana as of Sunday stood at 89 percent complete, well above the 32 percent pace of a year ago and ahead of the average pace at 73 percent, according to the Indiana Agricultural Statistics Service.
Heavy rains last week kept farmers from the fields with only one day suitable for fieldwork, the report said.
Corn conditions were at four percent excellent, 46 percent good, 40 percent fair, seven percent poor and three percent very poor.

Eighty percent of the wheat crop was headed, above the 75 percent pace of a year ago and below the 89 percent average pace. Winter wheat conditions were 14 percent excellent, 53 percent good, 28 percent fair, four percent poor and one percent very poor.
Pasture conditions were 12 percent excellent, 57 percent good, 23 percent fair, six percent poor and two percent very poor.
Topsoil moisture levels were 69 percent surplus and 31 percent adequate.
